assets.axes: metres; Blender Z up; origin bottom centre; front = Blender -Y; glTF +Y up; stock UE glTF Interchange maps UE = 100 * (x_b, -y_b, z_b) (UEB 48725), so the front lands on UE +Y; decided (buffffff 48769): no export rotation, face it with actor/component yaw -90 at placement (like the UE mannequin); assets whose UE attach code needs mesh +X forward get revisited one by one

unreal.nanite: on by default on the UE side (unreal-epic-boss)
unreal.sockets: native SOCKET_ empties survive stock glTF Interchange (position); the <Asset>.sockets.json sidecar rotation is authoritative (PR227): plain [0, 0, 0], attach +X along barrel/shaft, +Z up
unreal.collision: UCX_/USP_ children are kept by stock glTF Interchange (UEB fixture A/B PASS)
